groups.description: Unleash your full potential on the road or trail with the Hoka Clifton 10—where every step feels like running on clouds. Featuring a fine-tuned midsole geometry and an improved forefoot fit, these silhouettes provide exceptional comfort and support through every stride. The new double-lace lock system enables easy on and off, while the refined heel with an enhanced underfoot transition ensures a smooth and stable ride.  Boasting a redefined rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame, these shoes improve stability and support for a seamless running experience. Push your limits and experience peak performance in the Hoka Clifton 10. Hoka Clifton 10 features:  Jacquard knit upper offers breathability and a snug fit. Molded EVA sockliner adds comfort and support. CMEVA midsole with Meta-Rocker technology delivers cushioning. Reflective upper details enhance low-light visibility. Inherently durable abrasion rubber outsole ensures excellent traction. Weight: 9.8 oz. Long runs, daily walks, and hours on your feet all feel easier in the HOKA Clifton 10. This updated favorite is built to keep your stride smooth and comfortable, pairing plush cushioning with a refined heel transition and an improved forefoot fit that helps you move confidently from the first mile to the last.Jacquard knit upper provides breathable, supportive comfort.Molded EVA sockliner adds step-in softness.CMEVA midsole and Meta-Rocker geometry help create a smooth, cushioned ride.Rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame adds stability and support.Double-lace lock system helps make on and off easier.Reflective details and a durable abrasion rubber outsole round out the design.Weight: 9.8 oz. Size & Fit Guidance Most reviewers say the fit feels true to size and comfortable right away. For the best fit, we recommend starting with your usual size; if you prefer extra room through the forefoot or typically choose wide widths, a wide option may feel best. Best For Best for daily running, walking, and long hours on hard surfaces when you want lightweight cushioning and dependable support. Cushioning & Road Feel Reviewers consistently highlight the soft, cloud-like cushioning and smooth ride underfoot. The feel leans plush and protective for pavement, recovery miles, and all-day wear, with comfort prioritized over a close-to-the-ground ride. Break-In & Durability Many wearers say the Clifton 10 feels good from the first wear, so it does not ask for much break-in time. Repeat HOKA buyers also point to reliable everyday performance across running, walking, and work shifts. Care & Maintenance To keep the knit upper looking fresh, use gentle spot cleaning as needed. One longtime wearer noted the shoe continued to hold up well even after multiple washes.
groups.title: HOKA Clifton 10 - Men's

groups.description: 'Experience boundless comfort through the journey with the HOKA Rincon 4. Renowned for their startling cushion-to-weight ratio, these shoes are upgraded from top to bottom, ensuring uber-light softness that helps you chase miles. Built to last and ready to blast, the HOKA Rincon 4 offers you a more foot-hugging fit than ever before and makes sure every stride feels like a first.   Upgraded foam provides better rebound and works together with rubberized EVA to increase longevity and offer a softer feel. Podular outsole design delivers advanced traction and durability. Long runs, daily miles, and busy days on your feet call for comfort that stays light from start to finish. The HOKA Rincon 4 is built to help you move smoothly with soft cushioning, an even lighter feel, and a more foot-hugging fit that keeps every stride feeling fresh. Updated from top to bottom, it balances plush comfort with the responsive feel you want when the pace picks up.Upgraded foam delivers softer cushioning with improved rebound.Rubberized EVA helps add durability without weighing you down.Podular outsole design provides reliable traction for everyday movement.  Size & Fit Guidance For the best fit, most reviewers say this pair feels true to size and comfortably secure. If you prefer a little extra room up front, especially for longer runs, going up a half size may work best.  Best For Best for runners and walkers who want a lightweight, cushioned shoe for everyday training, casual miles, and all-day comfort.  Cushioning & Road Feel The Rincon 4 stands out for its strong cushion-to-weight ratio, giving you a soft, easy ride without feeling bulky. Underfoot, it keeps the feel smooth and light so daily miles stay comfortable while still offering enough responsiveness for a steady rhythm on the road."
groups.title: HOKA Rincon 4 - Men's

groups.description: Experience unmatched speed and an energetic performance boost with the adidas adiZero Evo SL. Inspired by the record-breaking EVO 1, these shoes combine innovative technology with lightweight materials to help you push your limits in every run. The synthetic and textile upper ensures durability, breathability, and targeted support, while the Lightstrike Pro technology delivers super-light cushioning to keep you fast and agile on your feet. Constructed with at least 20% recycled content, the adidas adiZero Evo SL brings peak performance and sustainability, making every step count. adidas adiZero Evo SL features:  Regular fit gives a relaxed feel. Lace closure provides a snug and customised fit. Textile lining maximises comfort. 3-Stripes add a bold, signature look. Small stiffening element ensures a little extra snap in each step. All-surface rubber outsole delivers grip and traction.  *Designed to be a standard fit, not too tight or too loose.**By reusing materials that have already been created, adidas helps to reduce waste and reliance on finite resources and reduce the footprint of the products.When your training week calls for one shoe that can handle easy miles, uptempo sessions, and everything in between, the adidas adiZero Evo SL is ready to go. Inspired by the record-breaking EVO 1, this running shoe combines a lightweight build with energetic cushioning to keep transitions smooth and your stride feeling fast, whether you’re logging daily miles or picking up the pace.  Synthetic and textile upper offers lightweight breathability and targeted support. Lightstrike Pro cushioning delivers a soft, springy, super-light ride. Small stiffening element adds a little extra snap through toe-off. Lace closure and textile lining help create a secure, comfortable fit. Rubber outsole provides reliable traction across surfaces. Made with at least 20% recycled content.  Size & Fit Guidance Most runners say the fit feels true to size with a secure, locked-in feel. For the best fit, we recommend going with your usual size, while runners who prefer a little more room in the forefoot or toe box may want to try a half size up. Best For Best for daily training, speed sessions, and long road runs when you want lightweight comfort with a lively toe-off. Cushioning & Road Feel Reviews consistently highlight the adiZero Evo SL for its bouncy, responsive ride and smooth energy return. It balances protective cushioning with a light, connected feel that works especially well for road miles, tempo efforts, and versatile training days. Break-In & Durability Most runners say the shoe feels comfortable right away, with the fit settling in even more naturally after the first few runs. Reviewers also describe it as a dependable choice for regular training rotations and repeat wear.
groups.title: adidas Adizero Evo SL - Men's
